publishedfiledetails.title: Warly Quality of Life Changes
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
What are the main issues with Warly?
First of all his ingredients easily take up 8+ inventory slots.
Second, getting spices and onions for high quality food takes a lot of time and RNG.
This mod aims to solve both those problems.

The Fridgepack is a 12 Slot backpack crafted with 2 gears, 15 ice and 8 salt crystals.
It's half Icebox, half Saltbox and reduces spoilage time for all food items (including Hambats) by 50%. Additionally, uncooked ingredients have their spoilage time reduced by 75% when placed in one of the 6 freeze drying slots. That way Warly only misses out on a few slots compared to characters that can stack meatballs and pierogie.

The Veggie-Bundle is exactly what it sounds like. A simple bundling wrap containing
a tomaroot, an onion, a pepper and one garlic.

Both items have unique examination quotes for each survivor.

The Cookingpack is work in progress, but will eventually allow you to cook while moving, directly from your backpack.
Further updates may include new art and extra effects for spices.
(if you are an artist or want to contribute in other ways, please let us know)

Gigantic thank you to Electroely who did ALL of the coding, helped me with implementing art and came up with the Cookingpack.

publishedfiledetails.title: Heap of Foods
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/sKqdqP2.png[/img]
[list]
[*]This mod is purely about grinding and cooking food! With tons of new content about it, you will surely lose your mind when it comes to using the Crock Pot! 

[*]Featuring foods from [b]Shipwrecked[/b], [b]Hamlet[/b], [b]The Gorge[/b], [b]Unimplemented Foods[/b] and even [b]Exclusive Foods[/b] made only for this mod!

[*]Learn how to cook every recipe using the Mod's website: [url=https://heap-of-foods.com/]Visit it here![/url]
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/DzIvPEs.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Over 200 New Crock Pot Dishes:[/b] Uncover them and fill your Cookbook to the brim!

[*][b]Over 100 New Ingredients:[/b] Tons of new items to be used in the local cuisine.

[*][b]Over 10 New Plants:[/b] Farm Crops and many bountiful Bushes and Pickables to expand your repertoire of cooking ingredients.

[*][b]New Warly Spices:[/b] Feeling tired about the usual spices? Try the new ones, from setting your enemies ablaze to increasing food stats or even no spoilage penalties!

[*][b]Whole New Places:[/b] The Serenity Archipelago and the Seaside Island, where you will find tons of new content and mobs to assist you in your culinary journey.

[*][b]Reworked Monster Foods:[/b] Characters that can eat this type of food will gain the full benefits with no drawbacks anymore!

[*][b]The Gorge Cookware:[/b] Cooking foods will never be the same again! Each Cookware Station has an unique ability tied to them, from doubling your cooking yields to fully restoring the spoilage time of your food.

[*][b]A New Category of Foods:[/b] The Artisan Goods. Brew and produce an array of new beverages using the Wooden Keg and the Preserves Jar!

[*][b]The Fish Registry:[/b] Your compendium of Fish and roes! Research to know everything about them and their preferences for the Fish Hatchery.

[*][b]Daily Recipes:[/b] Daily Recipes are featured dishes selected everyday from the recipe pool. 
All players share the same recipe regardless of the world. Eating the daily recipe grants bonuses for Health, Hunger and Sanity. It also increases your Luck!
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/CIYS7m4.png[/img]
[list]
[*]The Artisan Products can be produced using the [b]Wooden Keg[/b] and the [b]Preserves Jar[/b]. They can be crafted near an Alchemy Engine under the Cooking Filter. 

[*]They take several days to brew. Some of them have special effects and they do not count towards the Cookbook, instead, they can be viewed at the [b]Brewbook[/b], which is an exclusive book for this new category of foods. 

[*]Wooden Kegs and Preserves Jars only accept specific ingredients such as Vegetables, Fruits, etc. Producing an invalid product will result in Sludge.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/aE3pUIp.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Seaside Island[/b] welcomes a new [b]Merchant[/b]! Assisted by a familiar survivor, he has opened a one-of-a-kind trading post, specializing in rare items and ingredients that are otherwise incredibly difficult to acquire and even some you won't find anywhere else.

[*]Make sure to check his wares every now and then to see what he has to offer. As his inventory is always changing, each day, each season, each occasion!
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/QWOcwnU.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Cast your line, set your sail, and dive into the ocean! A wave of new aquatic creatures awaits, whether you're a seasoned angler or just an apprentice, there's always something to catch! The seas are teeming with new life, but not everything that swims is friendly.

[*]Build yourself a [b]Fish Hatchery[/b] to raise your own fish in the comfort of your base, explore the ocean in search of elusive creatures, take part in [b]Ocean Hunts[/b], trade and deal with the mysterious [b]Ocean Merchant[/b] and find a friendly [b]New Companion[/b].

[*]Research [b]Fish[/b] and [b]Roe[/b] to have their information unlocked at your Fish Registry.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/OS4iCbb.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Q: What does this mod do?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] This mod adds over 200 new Crock Pot dishes and Ingredients to cook, as well as new plants and creatures. Some content of the game has been tweaked to match the new content in the mod. Already existing mechanics and items may have extra effects and abilities. New places can be found throughout the seas.

[*][b]Q: Recipes of the Wooden Keg / Preserves Jar don't appear on the Cookbook.[/b]
[b]A:[/b] These recipes are special and do not appear in the Cookbook. Instead they have their own book called [b]Brewbook[/b]. You can find it on the Cooking Filter of the Crafting Menu.

[*][b]Q: The inventory icons are bugged / Inventory icons are displaying wrong images.[/b]
[b]A:[/b] This is a common issue whenever the mod gets a new update. To solve this, simply restart the game (Not the world). If this issue continues to happen, please contact me.

[*][b]Q: Is this mod compatible with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=727774324&searchtext=craft+pot]Craft Pot Mod[/url]?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] Yes. It is! Craft Pot Mod should be able to tell you every recipe this mod has.

[*][b]Q: Does this mod work with other mods?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] I can't confirm that, sorry. If you're playing this mod along with other mods and have issues, please consider disabling them first and try again to see what is causing the problem. You can post your problem in the commentary section below.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ixxzslb.png[/img]
[list]
[*]This Mod currently has no official guide, but our community of fans has done an incredible job making their own guides! I'm sure this will help you with the basics!

[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2918508191]Guide in English (US)[/url]

[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2334209327/690868131878456544/]Click Here[/url] to see the Fish Hatchery List.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/VkSOFv8.png[/img]
[list]

Current supported localizations:

publishedfiledetails.file_description:
The 4 iconic Don't Starve: Reign of Giants bosses reimagined.
They're looking a little smaller than usual...?

[b]"Reign of Runts" is a 4 character mod that takes the classic RoG bosses: Deerclops, Bearger, Moose/Goose, and Dragonfly and turns them into Wilson-sized playable characters ripe with perks and personalities![/b]

[h1]The Runts[/h1]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/gJ2Lk0Sj/1BWde2X.png[/img][img]https://i.postimg.cc/HnJJXh1X/W4ykub-B.png[/img]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FRCdfQ8f/hp-Yb-Ohi.png[/img]
[i]"With clomps ringing in the cold winter night, a loud crash echoes throughout the forest. Deerclops will leave no structure unscathed."[/i]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2010472942/4754200580379729425/][b]Deerclops's Skill Tree[/b][/url] 

[b]•Packs an icy punch
•Has an aptitude for structure destructure
•With an increasing itch to destroy
•At home in the cold, but not the heat[/b] 

~ *Adds coldness and can freeze enemies while attacking. During Winter this becomes an AoE
~ Can destroy structures & rocks without an item equipped, hammers faster than others
~ Gets a *small amount of sanity while destroying free-hand, or with a hammer.
- Amount of sanity gained may differ depending on the size of a structure
- If you go too long without destroying a structure your sanity will start to drain, starting at *2 days. The longer without, the higher amount of sanity drained

~ *Immune to the cold and will passively get colder
- Overheats *much sooner, takes increased fire damage
~ Overheating damage is increased by *30%, Freezing damage is reduced by *80%
~ Won't lose sanity near a Deerclops, won't slip on ice

Favorite Food: Melonsicle
Voice: Viol
Birthday: February 26
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/85XJFV9j/9a-Rm-Dw-W.png[/img]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/PxVpLk9X/2Aii-BUa.png[/img][img]https://i.postimg.cc/TwNLyXFc/RFok-Fku.png[/img]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/D0WWLM34/SQd-YRDR.png[/img]
[i]"Bearger is a simple, gluttonous beast whose only goal is to feed and sleep throughout the frigid seasons."[/i]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2010472942/4140563392629647860/][b]Bearger's Skill Tree[/b][/url] 

[b]•"Hibearnates" in chilly weather
•Bears an angry stomp
•Has a hankering hunger for honey[/b] 

~ Using RMB, Bearger can slam the ground doing additional AoE *damage, with double damage if close
- Ground pound affects trees, *plants, and *stumps, doesn't affect structures or flying creatures
- Hunger drains *20% faster
~ Gets additional sanity from Honey foods, takes *50% less damage from bees, and will *occasionally drop a fur tuft
- Will wake up groggy from naturally sleeping

~ During Winter & Spring Bearger will go into "Hibearnation" mode
 During "Hibearnation": 
 Hunger doesn't drain 20% faster, small winter insulation, small damage absorption (*20%)
 Will occasionally yawn instead of doing a ground pound, taking hunger
 If hunger is fuller than 50% Bearger's max hp is set to 200 and winter insulation increased. Likewise, if it's below 50% it'll be set to normal

Favorite Food: Honey Ham
Voice: Bassoon
Birthday: September 1
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/DZpJWKHZ/Dui-MQUS.png[/img]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Ss12Xp3W/MH58QOi.png[/img][img]https://i.postimg.cc/JnYDyWvh/63NQi-Vh.png[/img]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/V6ZrScpC/iyg-N4UO.png[/img]
[i]"It's a lovely morning in the constant, and you are a motherly moose. ...and goose."[/i]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2010472942/6597293740379607401/][b]Moose/Goose's Skill Tree[/b][/url] 

[b]•Can form a feisty whirlwind
•Enjoys walks on the ocean
•Has a tendency of getting wet feathers
•Aspiring nester[/b]

~ *Can use RMB to Spin for a boost. Deals damage in AoE, *Includes trees & rocks
- Spin will cause grogginess after. Can't spin while groggy.
~ While attacking, has a *10% chance to unleash a loud Honk that confuses some mobs in a small radius
- *Refuses to eat Eggs and Egg-based foods

~*Aspiring Nester: Can build the "Motherly Nesting", a nest only she can place
 It provides a passive sanity gain and a *25% defense bonus for all within its AoE, but only when a Moose/Goose is in it
 Any Moose/Goose in its AoE will drain hunger quicker
 She can place a Tallbird Egg in the nest that will allow the buff to persist within its AoE if she's not near it
 Needs attending: will collapse within *7 days if proper attention isn't given (With fuel items like twigs). Can be dug up, but will collapse if durability isn't high

~ Is able to run on the ocean, but Wetness will quickly fill up as you're on it. Protective gear or fire won't stop it
- If you're over *100% Wetness you'll drown. Can't walk on water again until below 100%
- Wetness naturally fills *60% faster
~ *Increased lightning attraction, lightning heals instead of damages. When Spring ends she molts a few feathers
~ The Moose/Goose & Mosslings will be more passive

Favorite Food: Flower Salad
Voice: Harmonica
Birthday: March 6
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/gjww8Tby/Yw-EVVjz.png[/img]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/RFp63zy7/JRZ3Mqt.png[/img][img]https://i.postimg.cc/C5ZZkQpf/t-Et-Xgs-W.png[/img]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/wMttLGYD/zamwtm0.png[/img]
[i]"With her draconic temperamental roots, Dragonfly finds her new situation to be that of one to surmount with riches."[/i]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2010472942/4210371957563763889//][b]Dragonfly's Skill Tree[/b][/url] 

[b]•Has a short fuse
•And a fiery attitude
•A dragon heat barely beats
•Can enkindle life[/b]

~ Increased overheating threshold, *fire immunity
~ Can eat Ash and Charcoal. (2 HP & Hunger)
~ Eating *8 Ashes in quick succession she'll enter her Enraged form. Over eating ash will cause grogginess.
~ Getting attacked while under 100 health has a 70% chance for her to enrage
 Rage:
 Dragonfly will do an fiery stomp on enrage, hurting nearby enemies. Lasts for *1 minute.
 Deals *increased damage while attacking, *occasional damage bursts, a *slight speed boost, hunger & sanity drain, *+70 max hp, a high temperature during (Fire damage is off by default)
 Dying, freezing, falling asleep, or wetness over 30% will revert your rage
 Eat ice to not enrage or have damage bursts (1 min)
- Cannot enrage if wetness is over 30% or temperature is below freezing
- Rage has a *30 second cooldown

~ Can summon Lavae companions via Magma Ponds who will attack enemies you target
~ Max of *10 Lavae, *500 HP, requires feeding or it'll perish, can be cooked upon, *50 dmg, emits warmth and light but not wildfires
- Summoning costs 20 Health and Hunger, if Ash is in your inventory it will consume 1 but halve the penalty
- Lavae will die on being frozen, sanity loss on death, losing all Lavae causes rage

Favorite Food: Hot Dragon Chili Salad
Voice: Hurdy Gurdy
Birthday: November 30
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Bb88HVfD/vlh-WSac.png[/img]

( * = Configurable )

[h1]Featuring Skins[/h1]

[h1]🎮 NPC Friends — Don't Starve Together Companion System[/h1]



[b]⚠️ Required: Must install [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3678857150]DstAdmin[/url] to use the management panel[/b]



[hr][/hr]



Spawn unique NPC companions throughout the world of Don't Starve Together.

Some wait near the portal, others are scattered across the map — find them, offer any food, and recruit them as permanent companions!



[hr][/hr]



[h2]📋 Character Roster[/h2]



[h3]🤝 Recruitable NPCs(16))[/h3]

[list]

[*] [b]Wilson[/b] — 🎣 Auto-fishing & smart storage

[*] [b]Wormwood[/b] — 🌱 Planting, weeding & tending — fully automated

[*] [b]Warly[/b] — 🍳 Auto-cooking, kitchen building, cooking speed ×2

[*] [b]Wes[/b] — 🧹 Auto-organize containers & pick up ground items | 24-slot backpack

[*] [b]Winona[/b] — 🔧 Cleaning + craft generators / spotlights / catapults

[*] [b]Woodie[/b] — 🪓 Auto-chopping, transforms in combat

[*] [b]Willow 薇洛[/b] — 🔥 Fire immunity, Bernie auto-assist, crafts Rainbow Fireflies

[*] [b]Wendy 温蒂[/b] — 👻 Abigail combat support, automatic ocean fishing

[*] [b]Wickerbottom[/b] — 📚 Auto fire suppression / temperature control / dehumidify, bee guard summon, lightning strike

[*] [b]Wathgrithr[/b] — ⚔️ Damage +25%, armor 25%, lifesteal on hit, battle song buff

[*] [b]Wolfgang[/b] — 💪 Tri-state: wimpy / normal / mighty, hunger-driven

[*] [b]Wortox[/b] — 💜 Auto-detect ally status, group healing, soul hop

[*] [b]Wanda[/b] — ⏳ Age system, rift teleportation

[*] [b]Maxwell[/b] — 🌑 Summon shadow guards & shadow workers

[*] [b]Walter[/b] — 🏕️ Auto campfire storytelling, ranged slingshot combat, exclusive ammo crafting, Woby support

[*] [b]Wonkey[/b] — 🍌 Crafts banana bushes/monkeytails/ancient tree seeds, specializes in bananas and shiny loot

[*] [b]Wilba[/b] — 👑 Issues daily quests — gather or slay to earn rewards
[/list]



[h3]💀 Hostile NPCs (2)[/h3]

[list]

[*] [b]Webber[/b] — 🕷️ Spawns near spider dens, summons spiders, drops loot on defeat

[*] [b]Wurt[/b] — 🐟 Spawns at merm houses, drops loot on defeat

[/list]



[hr][/hr]



[h2]🔥 Core Systems[/h2]



[h3]🍖 Recruitment[/h3]

[list]

[*] Feed any food to recruit

[*] Each player can have up to 2–3 NPC companions (configurable)

[*] Right-click to dismiss — the NPC stays in place waiting for the next adventurer

[/list]



[h3]👻 Soul System[/h3]

[list]

[*] NPCs don't vanish on death! They become translucent souls and keep following

[*] Souls slowly regenerate health and auto-revive when full

[*] Can be revived with Tell-Tale Heart or Life Giving Amulet

[/list]



[hr][/hr]



[h2]⚒️ Work System[/h2]



Assign jobs through the DstAdmin panel — NPCs start working immediately:



[h3]🌱 (Wormwood)[/h3]

Follow to plowed land → Work Here → Plant → Tend → Harvest → Store


[h3]🍳 (Warly)[/h3]

Follow to crockpot & icebox → Work Here → adjustable work range


[h3]🎣 (Wilson)[/h3]

Auto-fish at ponds → Store catches in designated containers, customizable deposit point & catch limit



[h3]🪓 (Woodie)[/h3]

Auto-chop trees within work range, chopping speed ×2, transforms into Werebeaver in combat



[h3]🧹 (Wes / Winona)[/h3]

Auto-organize containers + pick up ground drops, keep your base tidy



[h3]🔧 (Winona)[/h3]

One-click craft tape, generators, spotlights & catapults — executes when materials are available



[h3]📚 (Wickerbottom)[/h3]

Passive aura: auto fire suppression, temperature control, dehumidify | Active skills: bee guard summon, lightning strike



[h3]💜 (Wortox)[/h3]

Auto-detect allies within 20 tiles, group heal to restore health, soul hop to stay close



[b]All work ranges can be adjusted in real-time through the panel[/b]



[hr][/hr]



[h2]⚔️ Smart Combat AI[/h2]



NPCs feature a complete kiting & dodge system:



[list]

[*] [b]Backstep Dodge[/b] — Pull back in a straight line

[*] [b]Sidestep Dodge[/b] — Lateral movement while maintaining line of sight

[*] [b]Orbit Dodge[/b] — Circle around the target continuously

[*] [b]Fire Evasion[/b] — Detect and avoid nearby flames

[/list]



[list]

[*] Multi-target threat detection: scans enemies within 20 tiles

[*] Auto-retreat & eat when low HP, re-engage when healed

[*] Auto-assist when allies are under attack

[/list]



[hr][/hr]



[h2]🖥️ Management Panel (Requires DstAdmin)[/h2]



Left-click any NPC to open the management panel — all-in-one control:



[list]

[*] 📊 Real-time health / hunger / sanity display

[*] 🔘 Follow / Unfollow toggle

[*] ⚒️ Work command buttons (farm / cook / fish / chop / clean / stop)

[*] 📐 Work range display + real-time adjustment

[*] 🎣 Catch limit & deposit point settings (Wilson)

[*] 🍳 Same-dish limit adjustment (Warly)

[*] 🔧 Winona exclusive crafting buttons

[*] ⏳ Wanda rift teleport button

[/list]



[hr][/hr]



[h2]💬 Rich Dialogue System[/h2]



[list]

[*] NPCs talk during combat, work, idle, injury and more

[/list]



[hr][/hr]



[h2]👔 Skin System[/h2]



[list]

[*] Automatically reads character skins from your Steam inventory

[*] Right-click NPC to apply skins — saved persistently

[/list]



[hr][/hr]



[h2]🍬 Growth System[/h2]



Defeating hostile NPCs (Webber / Wurt) has a chance to drop:

[list]

[*] [b]Sugar Cube I[/b] — Permanently increases max health +10

[*] [b]Sugar Cube II[/b] — Permanently increases base damage +2

[/list]



[hr][/hr]



[h2]⚙️ Configuration[/h2]



[list]

[*] Max followers per player: 1 / 2 / 3 (default 2)

[*] Each NPC character can be individually enabled or disabled

[*] All work parameters adjustable via panel or config file

[/list]



[hr][/hr]



[h1]📌 Installation[/h1]

[list]

[*] [b]Must[/b] also subscribe to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3678857150]DstAdmin[/url] Mod


[*] Dedicated server supported

[/list]

publishedfiledetails.title: 【Celestial Champion】dodge/dash update
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
CC is an ACT-oriented character designed for hardcore players. She trades traditional "tanking" capabilities for extreme mobility, precision parries, and high-frequency combos.

Recommended World Setting: Set all Bosses to "Lots" to match her high-tempo combat style.

Combat Style: High-Tempo / No-Hit Flawless.

Core Gameplay: Utilize the Backstep Watch for dodges and Celestial Aegis for parries. Enter "Limit Break" to trigger death-immunity and high-mobility solo combat.

Base Stats
Health: 125 (Core Health: 25)

Sanity: 275

Hunger: 150

Survival Constraints:

Mind Collapse: Dying immediately when Sanity reaches 0.

Medical Rejection: Cannot use conventional healing items.

Armor Penalty: Physical defense effectiveness is reduced by 30% when wearing armor.

Dietary Restriction: Only eats Vegetables, Fruit, Seafood, and Leafy Meat.

Penalty Immunity: No Max HP penalty upon death or drowning.

I. Health Phases & Sanity Logic
CC’s state shifts dynamically based on her current Max HP limit:

Phase 1 (Max HP > 75): Basic Mode. No special bonuses.

Phase 2 (Max HP 25 ~ 75): Agile Mode. Movement Speed +5%; reduced dodge cooldown.

Phase 3 (Max HP = 25): Extreme Mode. Movement Speed +10%; shortest dodge cooldown. Gain Planar Defense, Entity Resistance, +10 Planar Damage, and Temperature Resistance. Enables Limit Break and Stealth Master.

Sanity Synchronization:
Current Sanity and Max Sanity are real-time synchronized.

High Sanity (>85%): Allows food to restore Health.

Mid-Low Sanity: Food provides no healing; triggers varying levels of Auto-Regeneration. Below 50% allows aggressive combat against Shadow Creatures.

Insanity (<25%): Maximum health regeneration, but becomes vulnerable to Shadow Creature aggression.

II. Combat Mechanics
1. Limit Break (极限爆发)

Trigger: Activated in Phase 3 via successful dodges, Perfect Parries, or high-frequency burst damage.

Buffs: +10% Movement Speed, Temperature Lock, and Immunity to Knockback/Slows.

Death Immunity: Staying in combat for 15s (9s with Bone Armor) without taking damage grants a "Death-defying Medal": forced survival at 1 HP upon fatal damage.

2. Stealth Master (潜行大师)

Trigger: Passive (taking damage in Phase 3) or Active (out of combat for 30s).

Effect: Force-clears aggro, becomes untargetable, and provides minor health regeneration.

3. brilliance dash (辉煌冲刺 - X 键)

Utility: Consumes Max Sanity to blink toward the cursor. Breaks CC (crowd control) states, marks targets, and triggers electric discharge.

Synergy: In Phase 3, it has near-instant startup and a 1s cooldown.

III. Exclusive Gear & Skills
Celestial Aegis (天体戎卫): 85% Defense shield. Perfect Parries restore Sanity, Max Sanity, and Durability.

Backstep Watch (倒走表): The core dodge tool. Successful dodges restore Max Sanity and Health.

Enlightened Diadem (启蒙皇冠): The final upgrade form. 60% Defense, +10% Movement Speed. Provides light and extra inventory slots that preserve food.

Lunar Energywhip (月能鞭): Damage scales with Sanity. Deals Planar Damage and can be auto-repaired by the Diadem.

Magnificent Ornament (华丽替身): A resurrection effigy. Upon revival, refreshes Max Sanity and grants a Speed Boost, but locks Health at 1.

Rift Backup (裂隙摇人): Use the Rift Watch to summon Wanda for teleportation or timed combat support.

publishedfiledetails.title: Toru, The Head Doctor
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
Toru, the Head Doctor, and Wonder of U, from Jojo's Bizarre Adventure. They journey into the Constant with a special transformation and multiple abilities, unique voices (a violin and distorted cello), 2 weapons, and more!

Commission for [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/drsteelvoltaire/]Judas[/url]!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/8kyyrvgW/MP539d-L.png[/img] 

[h1]Stats & Perk Overview[/h1]
Health: 50 | Hunger: 150 | Sanity: 100
1.3x defense reduction | Cannot wear head gear

[list][*][b]Hard To Follow:[/b] Enemies who pursue Toru or Wonder of U will suffer various passive effects.
[*][b]Is Frail:[/b] Only has 50 health, but will passively dodge 1 attack every 20 seconds.
[*][b]Has a Bug Collection:[/b] Can craft two unique items, the [b]Obladi Oblada[/b] and [b]Dododo De Dadada[/b].
[*][b]The Flow of Limited Calamity:[/b] Can call forth the [b]Wonder of U[/b].[/list]

[hr]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/m2tm3rTy/m-JNduo-O.gif[/img]
[h1]WONDER OF U[/h1]
[i]"Wonder of U, the flow of calamity is the flow of logic."[/i]

Toru calls forth Wonder of U automatically when taking damage, or manually by pressing "Z" (configurable).

[list][*]Immune to damage, but cannot attack.
[*]Can walk through objects and walk over water [i](be careful when turning back into Toru, as he will drown!)[/i]
[*]Cannot lose (or gain) sanity, hunger, or health.
[*]Moves 70% slower than normal, but can teleport anywhere on screen [i](once per transformation.)[/i]
[*]Cannot equip hand [i]or[/i] head items.[/list]

Wonder of U's transformation lasts 15 seconds. After turning back into Toru, the transformation will be inaccessible for 60 seconds.

Wonder of U has a unique ability, [b]Calamity Flow[/b].
[list][*]Summons a rain cloud above target [i](Alt-Click to use)[/i]
[*]Increases target's damage taken by 1.6x [i](Lasts 30 seconds)[/i]
[*]Automatically turns back into Toru after use.
[/list]

[hr]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/76XyzLqv/03.gif[/img]
[h1]HARD TO FOLLOW[/h1]
[i]"I don't know what will happen to you. But you will die.. and soon."[/i]

Both Toru and Wonder of U have special passive effects whenever they are pursued (aka targeted) by a mob. 

Toru:
[list][*]Passive ability affects 1 mob at a time
[*]Pursuing mob takes 40 damage per second
[*]If mob is near a tree, causes the tree to fall and deals 100 damage [i](once per mob)[/i]
[/list]
Wonder of U:
[list][*]Passive ability affects [i]all[/i] mobs at once
[*]Pursuing mobs takes 20 damage per second
[*]If mob is near a tree, causes the tree to fall and deals 100 damage [i](once per mob)[/i]
[*]If mob tries to attack Wonder of U, deals 60 damage and knocks them back a large distance.[/list]

[hr]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/NfDr08hq/02.gif[/img]
[h1]OBLADI OBLADA[/h1]
[i]"It’s part of my evacuation drill."[/i]

[list][*]Recipe: Rocks x4
[*]Equippable Item
[*]Can be thrown at a mob to freeze them in place for 15 seconds
[*]Lasts 1 use (configurable)[/list]

[hr]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L6hTwd9d/04.gif[/img]
[h1]DODODO DE DADADA[/h1]
[i]"The asbestos should help slow my enemies down."[/i]

[list][*]Recipe: Sticks x4
[*]Trap [i](place on ground to use)[/i]
[*]Slows down all mobs within range by 40%
[*]Lasts 2 days[/list]

[hr]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/bNg2vx7L/01.gif[/img]
[h1]LOKAKAKA FRUIT & TREE[/h1]
[i]"Equivalent exchange should occur if consumed."[/i]

The Lokakaka Fruit is Toru's starting item. It can be planted to create a Lokakaka Tree, or eaten to give random stat effects.
[list][*]Recipe: Seeds x5, Glommer Goop x5, Mosquito Sack x1
[*]Health, Hunger, and Sanity randomly gain or lose +15, -15, or +50 
[*]Spoils in 5 days[/list]

When chopped down, a Lokakaka Tree gives 1-3 logs (or charcoal if burnt) depending on its growth stage. When fully grown, chopping it down also yields 2 Lokakaka Fruit!

[h1]Nearly all of Toru and Wonder of U's character perks, abilities, and weapon stats can be configured. Please customize them to your liking![/h1]
[hr]
[h1]Modded Menu[/h1]
This mod has [b]a custom menu screen and song[/b]! To use, you must subscribe to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2415978456][API] Mods In Menu[/url] and enable this mod in the "MiM Mods" list.

This mod will still function if [API] Mods in Menu is not enabled, but the custom menu will be unavailable.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2415978456][img]https://i.postimg.cc/8CdxnF3R/NJjhjR1.png[/img][/url]
[hr]
[h1]TO DO[/h1]
[b]Bugfixes![/b] I've tried my best to bugfix before release, but I am only one person and may have missed a few things. If you notice anything not working as intended, please report it in the BUG REPORTS/KNOWN BUGS discussion.

[h1]DISCLAIMER/FUTURE UPDATES?[/h1]
This mod, despite being posted now, is actually nearly 2 years old. The commissioner originally intended to add more content and re-balance the mod before release, but quickly became too busy with real life to do so. Rather than let it sit in limbo any longer, they've decided to release the mod as-is for other Jojo fans to enjoy.

Due to the gap in time between creation and publishing, I am unfortunately not nearly as familiar with the code as I would've been when originally writing it. I'm [i]pretty[/i] sure this written description is up to date, but I might've missed some small perks. Some of the code and art may also be a bit dated compared to my more recent mods.

There are no future updates currently planned for this mod, however, the commissioner has given approval for anyone who enjoys this mod to commission new content for it or create custom speech files for Toru and Wonder of U to use.
